summary: This note traces the history of Myanmar Airways International, a Myanmar airline. It was founded by the government before independence in 1946 as Union of Burma Airways, initially serving only domestic routes. The airline was renamed several times, and its international services were transferred to Myanmar Airways International, set up in 1993.
one_line: History of Myanmar Airways International, from its 1946 founding as Union of Burma Airways through its renamings to 1993.
key_facts: The airline was founded by the government before independence in 1946 as Union of Burma Airways.
Union of Burma Airways initially operated domestic services only.
International services were added to the airline in 1950.
The name was changed to Burma Airways in December 1972.
The airline was renamed Myanma Airways on April 1, 1989.
The 1989 name change followed the renaming of the country from Burma to Myanmar.
International services were transferred to Myanmar Airways International.
Myanmar Airways International was set up in 1993.
